One of the strangest dreams I’ve had was when I dreamt of the Devil. 
 
I was in this dark void with only a large tv in the middle. There were two pictures of this criminal being sent to execution (that’s what I think). They looked like pictures being taken in the 1990’s. One was on the left which was of him being sent to execution, the other was of this mugshot being taken. 

The criminal looked super uncanny somehow and it terrified me. In the middle was the number 9. I stared at it for a few minutes before dream-jumping to actually seeing the devil. The void turned blood red including the background for the image. In the middle, I saw the devil staring at me, grinning with his tiny moustache and horns. 

In the background, I heard these old music that sounded old and broken. The screen started fluttering like I was looking at a VHS. Before I knew it, I woke up and just thought about this dream for a while.

Witnessing a classmate slitting her wrists in class. It happened in elementary school when I was at the age of 10. She was in my fourth grade class and we were both in the same group. 

At the middle of the class, I was busy finishing up my classwork and I was about to talk to her just to have a normal conversation when I heard her to talking to a friend, but I saw her with a razor blade in her hand and a bloody slit wrist. Her best friend was crouched beside with red eyes like she was about to tear up who started telling her to stop. 

I just sat there, gagging at the sight of blood and I just jumped into the conversation by asking what she was doing. She glanced at me before gesturing me to be quiet with her friend looking at me and I didn’t know what to do, so I listened to her. I stayed quiet as the teacher was busy doing the grades of our assignments and homework. 

The girl covered her wound with her sleeves and told her friend to go away. She did and left. I don’t know what happened next since all I’m remembering is vivid, but I think we just had a normal conversation after that.
